summary: Tested the new PDF cases (61-68, 81-91), the single-child scope and the printable family-pattern report. Backend: the engine function gives the same answer as the baseline fixture for all 392 inputs (0 differences). In the baseline, every non-3+3 input has the same answer for child 1 and child 2. The new table entries match docs/source/pdf_transcription.json, and cases 84, 87 and 92 are still not in the table. A new live API test file passes 12/12: case 61 (origin original_pdf, not borrowed, group single_child, female, label 'Baby'), case 81 (female) and case 91 (male). Input 84 still returns male from case 75 (borrowed), 87 still returns female from 72, and 92 is still not_in_table. A 3+3 request without child_number returns 400 child_number_required with en/ar/de messages. 3+3 with child 1/2 gives first_child/second_child. A non-3+3 request with child 1, child 2 or no child number returns the same id (deduped) with request and inputs child_number null. The single-child label is 'طفل' in AR and 'Kind' in DE. 30 random baseline pairs checked through the API: 0 differences. Unit tests pass 159/159 (family_pattern, pdf_comparison, mendelian, scientific_integrity) and format.test.js passes 10/10. Frontend (Clerk ticket session): the child-number choice appears only for 3+3, otherwise the single-child-note is shown in EN/AR/DE. The Print report button is on the result card and on the History detail page. The report is placed under body: hidden on screen, shown in print media, and #root is hidden in print. It contains the report number (analysis id), date, wife, husband, answer, source, traditional note and limitations. Checked: 'Baby: Girl' with 'Table case #37 · Old App Only'; 'Baby: Boy' with 'Answer taken from table case #75 (Wife: Boy · Husband: Girl, Boy, Girl)' plus both 'Owner review pending' notes; 3+3 'Second child: Boy' with case #34 Old App Only; not-in-table '—' with the localized not-in-table text. Arabic report has dir=rtl and is fully translated; German is translated. History summary has no 'First child' suffix for new single-child entries and shows '· Second child' for 3+3. No page errors.

issues: The report number is the raw 24-character MongoDB id. It works, but a shorter human-friendly number might be easier for the owner to read (optional).
The reference title is still English in AR/DE (carried over from iteration 7, optional).

critical_code_review_comments: family_pattern.py: _validate rejects 3+3 without child_number. The model validator sets child_number to None for non-3+3 inputs, so dedupe works. Correct.

History entries saved before this change, for non-3+3 inputs with child_number 1/2, still have child_number in their stored request. Their summary still shows '· First child' and their group is first_child. These new requests will not dedupe against them. This is expected and not a bug, but the owner may notice the difference in old History.
FamilyPatternReport repeats the kids() helper that is also in ResultView.TableCase and format.js. It is small, but it could be shared.
